why: In crypto, Jev + research scores 0.151 against the market's 0.087 over 56 resolved markets. Bold is down $20.3k, the worst of any strategy, on 33 settled. Skipping crypto leaves bold differing from main only in its info gate (0.35 vs 0.5), which makes it a clean test of that gate.

why: Claude direct's forecasts trail the market (paired Brier 0.182 vs 0.153 on 357 markets), so its 8c 'edges' are probably mostly error. Its bets lose $68 per $100 (9 settled). This is an experiment; ch3 tried a pickier Claude direct and was retired, but it did that without the 30c floor.
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, P&L per $100 staked beats claude_direct's all-time -$51 per $100 and is no worse than main's over the same period.

why: Jev alone, bold has lost all 3 of its bets at 60c and up (-$6.0k), while its 30-60c bets are +$914 on 6. Jev alone is the weakest forecaster (Brier 0.235), and paying 60c+ leaves little room for its error. This rests on only 3 bets, so it is an experiment.
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, P&L per $100 staked beats its since-floor -$4.9 per $100 and its all-time -$43 per $100.

why: Sports is the only category where any forecaster beats the market (Claude 0.158 vs market 0.176, on 131 markets), yet ch16 has placed 1 bet in about 2.5 days. judge_by: On bets opened after this change, ch16's P&L per $100 staked is positive and ahead of claude_direct's over the same period.

why: Jev + research trails the market by about 0.06 Brier on 559 paired markets, so many of its 8c 'edges' are probably forecast error. Main loses about $26 per $100 since the floor (11 settled) and trails original per dollar on the yardstick (-$32 vs -$22 per $100). Requiring 12c, as claude_direct now does, tests whether fewer, stronger-conviction bets lose less. This is an experiment on small numbers.
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, main's P&L per $100 staked on the yardstick (shared markets) is better than original's over the same period, and better than main's since-floor -$26 per $100. If main places fewer than 10 bets in a week, revert to 0.08.

why: ch13 has placed only 5 bets in about 4.5 days. The 30 markets it skipped only because of Jev's info gate would have returned +$4.15 per $100 (19 wins), the only gate-blocked group in the ledger with a meaningful count that shows a profit. Lowering the gate from 0.5 to 0.35, bold's setting, should give it more bets at 55c and up. This is an experiment on noisy numbers.
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, ch13 places at least 2 bets a day, and its P&L per $100 staked is positive and no worse than calibrated's over the same period.

why: Claude trails the market badly outside sports: politics 0.255 vs 0.117 (13 markets), weather 0.208 vs 0.072 (19), other 0.138 vs 0.099 (19), crypto 0.134 vs 0.110 (37). It beats the market in sports (0.161 vs 0.177, 146 markets) and probably in culture (0.040 vs 0.089, but only 5 markets). Since its edge rose to 12c it has settled only 2 bets, so this is an experiment. It also sets up a comparison with ch16: a strict sports Claude (12c edge, info gate 0.5) against a loose one (8c edge, info gate 0.2).
judge_by: On bets opened after this change, Claude direct's P&L per $100 staked is positive and beats its all-time -$55 per $100. We also compare it with ch16's over the same period to see whether the strict or the loose sports setup earns more per $100.
